name: Asahi Net,Inc.
summary: Asahi Net, Inc. is an internet service provider in Japan offering high-speed fiber-optic connections, SIM cards for mobile use and portable Wi-Fi rentals. It also develops and sells educational support software, including manaba, a learning management system for universities. Dating from 1990 as ATSON, Inc., it was renamed in January 2001 and has its head office in Tokyo, Japan.
